This application under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed by the petitioners, namely, 1. Sri Pulen Barman and 2. Smti Jumi Barman, who are apprehending their arrest in connection with BI(EO) P.S. Case No. 06/2024, under Sections 120B/420/406/409 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.
Since this is for the 3rd time, the petitioners have approached this court after their earlier two applications being rejected.
This court intends to peruse the Case Diary before passing any order in this case.

The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that this anticipatory bail application is not maintainable as no new ground has been pleaded after rejection of the bail application on two earlier occasions.
6. Let this matter be listed on 19th December, 2025.
